post.originalText:
I gave Claude Opus 5.5 one prompt: make a 4-minute animated short that blows my mind.

It wrote the story, directed 12 AI agents, and generated every frame, the orchestral score, and all sound effects in code. Voices by @elevenlabsio.

Rendered on my MacBook. 🎬 https://t.co/Uklfs651mL
